what: A grid is built from columns of n column widths plus m gaps and rows of % height, and square cells are laid on specified cells (data-grid) or on a diagonal walking path (30% fill, no shared edges). When it reaches 75% of the screen, cells turn on row by row over 1.6s power4.out at .2s intervals (circ.in distribution). The scrub type is tied to scroll at 1.5s · .15 intervals, the hover type turns cells on one by one at .08s intervals when hovering the wrapping link and reverses on leave, and the veil type turns on and off from the bottom row over .3s on fx:cover · fx:uncover events (page transition curtain)

options.cols: Cell widths [[columns, slots], …] — also accepted via the data-cols attribute (JSON)
options.rows: Row height % list [30, 40, 30] — also settable via the data-rows attribute
options.data-grid: (optional) Per-cell true/false 2D array — without it, a random walk each time it opens
options.dur · each: Turn-on duration and stagger (sec), default scroll 1.6·.2 · scrub ·.15 · hover ·.08 · veil .3
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger start·end, default top 75% · bottom bottom(scrub)
options.host: Ancestor selector that receives the interaction in the hover type, default a, [data-fx-part=host]
options.--fx-column · --fx-gutter: Width of one column and one gutter (via style), default 1fr · 0px — pass the page grid variables and the cells interlock with the body columns

from.where: shared.js .at-divider · .at-veil · .at-foot__pattern · list.html thumbnail (PatternDivider · PageTransition · PatternFooter · PatternThumbnail)
